meta.title: See the agents working in this checkout: proposed

frontend.label: UI step where the work started

nodes.label: Running agents trigger
nodes.explanation: The bot icon and the count of agents in this checkout stay on the bar in every state, so nothing on the bar moves when the first agent starts or the last one stops (STATE-2, CC-33; toolbar-shell keeps the segment's place). It spins while an agent works; while one waits for the person it takes a waiting shape with '1 waiting', distinct in shape, text and name, also in forced colors (SURF-8, ACT-7, ACT-13): 'Running agents: 2 agents · 1 waiting for you', described 'this checkout' (WORD-5, WORD-6). With none it shows '0', 'No agents in this checkout'; with chat off it stays without a count and the list says 'Running agents are shown while chat is on.' with Edit at the setting's line (MENU-3, MENU-4, SEL-11). A terminal agent that waits raises a condition notice, 'Claude Code waits for you in its terminal · main ~/acme · since 14:10', with no answer of devhost's own (FB-8, REV-9); collapsed, toolbar-shell's badge keeps the wait in ACT-7's order (SURF-8). Keys: Alt+Ctrl+B, then the trigger is an arrow stop (KEY-3, KEY-4). Resolves the control that vanished at zero in reload-and-agents-05; the waiting look draws the state agent-chat publishes for chat-approvals-03 (related).

sources.label: Replaces: trigger that renders nothing at zero
Reuses: control placed in the toolbar

nodes.label: Agents in this checkout
nodes.explanation: An anchored toolbar panel opens above docked chat, never over the notice stack, in either corner (SURF-1, SURF-2, SURF-7, CC-1; the layer is toolbar-shell's). Its status line reads 'main ~/acme · 2 agents · 1 waiting for you · checked 14:02:10' (SEL-4, ACT-12). Rows name agents for people: 'Claude Code · Fix the nav header · This checkout (live)' over 'waiting for you since 14:10 · checkout root' with Answer, else Open Conversation; 'Codex in a terminal · PID 83275' over 'working · packages/ui · active 1 min ago', with no action, and a terminal agent that waits says to answer it in its terminal (SEL-8, WORD-1, WORD-6, WORD-8, REV-9). Waiting rows come first; agents of the stack's other checkouts follow after a separator, each with its checkout, so a switch hides none (SEL-5, CC-38; chat-checkout-switch-01 related). Watch Live Activity sits under the rows, and a filter appears when they overflow (SURF-10, SEL-10). Keys: Enter opens it with focus on the first row action; Tab past the last control closes it to the trigger; Escape closes it (KEY-6, KEY-7, KEY-8, KEY-10). Resolves reload-and-agents-05's rows (raw IDs, '.', no action).

sources.label: Replaces: rows of raw IDs, '.' and this chat
Replaces: row data with raw IDs, '.' for root

nodes.label: Decision card in chat
nodes.explanation: Answer on a waiting chat agent's row opens docked chat on that conversation with focus on its decision card's question, in one activation, also for a conversation of another checkout of the stack (REV-9, SEL-8, CC-38); Open Conversation opens it with focus in its composer, or on its transcript for another checkout's conversation (KEY-6). The list closes and sends nothing: the card, its keys and the answer are agent-chat's; Allow Once or Deny there reaches the agent through agent-chat's respond, one write it reports on the card, and devhost never answers or pre-approves (owner rule). With chat docked on another conversation, the hand-off switches to this one and keeps the other's draft (UNDO-2, agent-chat's). Today a waiting agent's row has no action and the trigger looks busy or idle, so learning that an agent waits takes 6 steps; now 3: the trigger's waiting look, the row, Answer. Removes the dead end of reload-and-agents-05's rows; chat-approvals-03 stays agent-chat's (related).

sources.label: Reuses: chat's decision card

nodes.label: Wait clears in place
nodes.explanation: When the agent's state leaves waiting, the row reads 'working' again, the trigger drops its waiting shape and '1 waiting', the collapsed badge follows, and a terminal agent's condition notice clears by itself, announced once in the polite region (ACT-7, FB-9, SURF-8); an agent chat started clears from its conversation's state. The outcome stays where the work started, in the list and on the trigger, with nothing to dismiss. There is no Undo: the list and the page only report, no rollback (UNDO-1) applies, and the answer, agent-chat's write, cannot be taken back.

nodes.label: Read agents record
nodes.explanation: While chat is on and the page is visible, the toolbar reads GET /__devhost__/agents every 10 s; one machine-wide scan serves every page for 5 s with a 10 s limit, as today. The record answers each agent's product name, PID, state and since when, checkout label and folder, and for an agent chat started its conversation's title, mode and state; the stack's other checkouts follow; it never carries a transcript path or a native session ID (Backend 1, 3). It says whether the scan was complete and which CLIs it could not list, without a path (Backend 2), and whether this browser runs on the stack's machine (isLocalClient, Backend 4). The same record names agents in worktree-switch's switch question and agent-chat's second-agent question, and stack-run-stop's multi-stack commands read it without a page URL (REV-3, REV-6, REV-7, FB-4); an agent chat started takes its conversation's state, which knows a pending approval for every CLI (ACT-6). Resolves reload-and-agents-09 (the page's schema dropped the scan error) and carries the names of reload-and-agents-05 and the flag of reload-and-agents-13.

Replaces: schema that drops the scan error
Reuses: poll every 10 s while visible

nodes.label: Some agents not listed
nodes.explanation: When devhost cannot list one CLI's agents, the record keeps what the others found; the trigger carries an incomplete mark, 'Running agents: at least 1 agent · Codex agents could not be listed', and the status line reads 'Codex agents could not be listed: devhost cannot read Codex's session folder. Details are in the stack's log.' with Check Again, the lead action, and Logs (MENU-3, MENU-5, HOLD-1, FAIL-2, SURF-13); 'No agents in this checkout' never shows then (STATE-3). Check Again asks for one fresh scan (fresh=1), keeps focus, busy, 'Checking…', and the line clears by itself, announced once (KEY-11, FB-9). When every CLI fails, the list keeps its last rows drawn as unknown with 'last seen 14:02' (STATE-4). devhost logs one line when a CLI starts failing and one when it recovers (FAIL-4). agent-chat's second-agent question asks too, naming what devhost could not check (REV-3, CC-14). Resolves reload-and-agents-09.

Replaces: error no page reads, logged per call

nodes.label: Watch Live Activity
nodes.explanation: Watch Live Activity opens in its own tab on http://127.0.0.1:<port>, the one link devhost opens outside the same tab (owner rule, SURF-15); the page answers only a direct loopback request, refuses routed hostnames with 403 and sends no-store and no-referrer, because transcripts can hold secrets, as today. Its heading names what it watches, 'Agent activity · Acme Shop · main ~/acme', with one state beside it: Live, Lost connection with Retry Now, Stopped or Could not start; its title reads 'Agent activity · Acme Shop', starting with 'Waiting for you · ' while an agent waits (O16, SEL-4, WORD-1, HOLD-2). With no entry yet it reads 'No activity yet. Agents in this checkout appear here when they start. History is not shown.' (STATE-2). It uses the document's standard keys (KEY-1). The tab is today's surface, kept on the run's own loopback port so page scripts cannot read transcripts; the list links to it only when this browser runs on the stack's machine.

sources.label: Reuses: direct loopback requests only
Replaces: header, Live badge, empty state

nodes.label: Stream entries + state
nodes.explanation: Each open page gets its own watcher from the end of every transcript, as today, with no history. Each event message gains its kind (prompt, reply, tool call, result, denied, turn end, stopped), its input (a shell tool's command, a file tool's path, an edit's path with the lines it adds and removes, cut at 4 KiB like the text) and, for an agent chat started, its conversation's title and mode, sent only on this loopback stream, never to the app's origin (Backend 5). A state message carries each agent's state and since when from the agents record, so a wait the transcripts never record shows (ACT-6, ACT-7). Before closing, the server sends ended, with the stack, the reason, the time and the start command, before 1001, or failed with its cause before 1011, and the socket helper passes each close's code and reason (Backend 6, ACT-10). Resolves the commands and waits missing in reload-and-agents-06 and the cause of reload-and-agents-10.

nodes.label: Entries by agent
nodes.explanation: Entries group under each agent's heading, named as in the list, 'Claude Code · Fix the nav header · PID 14625' or 'Codex in a terminal · PID 83275', so two agents of one CLI never interleave unnamed; each heading carries its state, such as 'waiting for you since 14:10 · answer in the page's chat' (SURF-8, ACT-7, WORD-6, REV-9). Newest first, at most 500: '14:10:47 · Tool call · Edit · src/header.tsx · +3 −1', 'Tool call · Bash · bun test', 'Result' with the output, 'Denied' for a refused call, never labelled user, 'Reply' rendered as Markdown with raw HTML shown as text, and 'Prompt'; text past 4,096 characters ends with 'cut at 4,096 characters' (WORD-1, WORD-4, WORD-10, FAIL-2). A turn the person stopped reads 'Stopped by you after 29 s', never as a failure (FAIL-5). A wait that starts or ends is announced once; entries sit outside every live region (FB-9). The page shows the wait and cannot answer it. Resolves reload-and-agents-06.

nodes.label: From another machine
nodes.explanation: The agents record says whether this browser runs on the stack's machine (isLocalClient: the client and every forwarded address are loopback, and the request did not come through a remote preview relay; Backend 4). On a page opened from another computer, Watch Live Activity stays in its place under the rows as an unavailable control, never a link: no 127.0.0.1 address is rendered there, so the page's URL and chat target never reach whatever listens on the viewer's own port. 'Watch Live Activity opens only in a browser on the machine that runs this stack.' stands beside it, said once, and is its accessible description; it keeps its Tab stop, and activating it opens nothing (MENU-3, HOLD-1, HOLD-7, SURF-15). On the stack's machine the link opens the page in its own tab, as today. A proposed extension of HOLD-7 to a read that works only on the stack's machine. Resolves reload-and-agents-13.

nodes.label: Page says Stopped
nodes.explanation: When devhost stop stops the stack with the page open, it reads 'Stopped' and 'Acme Shop stopped at 14:32 by devhost stop from a terminal. Start it with devhost start in ~/acme, then open Watch Live Activity from the running agents list on its pages.', keeps its entries under 'From the run that ended at 14:32' and stops reconnecting (ACT-10, HOLD-2, STATE-3). The idle timeout, Ctrl-C and devhost stack restart read the same way: a replaced stack's new run listens on a port the old page cannot learn, a proposed ACT-10 exception. A watcher that cannot start reads 'Watch Live Activity could not start: devhost could not create its watcher's files.' with Retry (FAIL-2, STATE-4). A connection dropped without a message reads 'Lost connection to devhost; retrying · next attempt in 8 s' with Retry Now (HOLD-2, ACT-5). In the list, a lost connection keeps the last rows as unknown with notices-and-feedback's reason. Resolves reload-and-agents-10.

cards.title: What changes versus today
items: Removed: the control vanishing with no agents, with chat off or when a scan misses every agent, and the bar's sideways jump; raw CLI IDs, '.' and generated session names as an agent's name; 'this chat' as the only link to chat; 'Waiting for approval' and 'Running, state unknown'; Watch Live Activity's raw tokens, tool output labelled user, unrendered Markdown and Reconnecting forever after a stop; the scan failure logged on every request
Merged: the trigger, the list, Watch Live Activity's headings and the questions of worktree-switch, agent-chat and stack-run-stop read one agents record with one state per agent

New: Answer and Open Conversation; conversation titles and modes; PID and 'in a terminal'; the stack's other checkouts; the waiting look; the incomplete mark with Check Again and Logs; 'No agents in this checkout' and the chat-off sentence; the status line; a filter on overflow; a terminal agent's waiting notice; the local-client flag; on Watch Live Activity, per-agent headings with state, each tool call's command or file, entry labels, rendered replies and the stopped, could-not-start and lost-connection states

Changed: the control stays at zero and with chat off (CC-33); its accessible name counts in words; tool inputs reach the loopback activity stream; a stream closed with 1001 after an ended message ends the page; the record lists the stack's other checkouts and answers without a page URL; a failed scan is shown; on a page opened from another machine Watch Live Activity is unavailable with its reason instead of a link to the viewer's own 127.0.0.1

Kept: agents devhost did not start are listed, subdirectories counted and subagents folded; waiting first; one shared scan per 5 s with a 10 s limit, read only while chat is on and the page is visible; no transcript path or native session ID on the app's origin; a failing CLI never hides the others' agents; Watch Live Activity on 127.0.0.1 with 403 for routed hostnames, no-store, no-referrer, its own tab, no history, 4,096-character cut, 500 entries and a watcher that stops with the tab; the list and the page never answer an agent; the agents routes answer 404 while chat is off and agents keep running; Restart Stack, switches and hot reloads keep the page live; a failed read keeps the last list, now with its age

cards.title: Tickets this journey resolves
items: Trigger, rows and the hand-off to chat: reload-and-agents-05 (rows and the empty control; the list's layer above docked chat is toolbar-shell's)
Agents record and incomplete scans: reload-and-agents-09
Watch Live Activity entries, waits and states: reload-and-agents-06
Watch Live Activity after a stop: reload-and-agents-10
A page opened from another machine: reload-and-agents-13
Related, not covered: chat-approvals-03, chat-approvals-08 and chat-checkout-switch-01 (agent-chat); chat-checkout-switch-02 (worktree-switch)

cards.title: Backend work
items: Agents record: product name, PID, state and since when, checkout label, folder, session name, and an agent chat started's conversation with title, mode and state; no transcript path or native session ID
Scan completeness: complete, the CLIs it could not list with a cause each, checkedAt; fresh=1 for Check Again; one log line when a CLI starts failing and one when it recovers
Every checkout of the stack, the page's first; a loopback read without a page URL for stack-run-stop's commands
isLocalClient on the record; requests through main's remote preview relay count as not local
Activity entries with kind, input and conversation on the loopback stream only, and state messages from the agents record
ended before 1001 and failed before 1011, from the stopped-stack record; the socket helper passes each close's code and reason
Recommended: each terminal agent that waits for the person, published on the status stream for the notice stack, the trigger and the badge

cards.title: Contract changes
items: CC-33: the running agents control stays with 'No agents in this checkout', and while chat is off says running agents are shown while chat is on
CC-1, landed by toolbar-shell: an open toolbar panel paints above docked chat, and nothing covers the notice stack
CC-18 and CC-38, landed by agent-chat: conversations stay answerable while chat is off and across the stack's checkouts
